newsitem.title: USA: Teledata to offer retail int'l calls.
newsitem.headline: Teledata to offer retail int'l calls.

text.p: TeleData World Services Inc said Thursday it has entered the international calling services business on a retail basis.
The company estimates a growth of 20 percent through the end of 1997 from this market segment. Revenues should approach $2 million a month before the end of 1997, Teledata said.
The company said the retail services will be sold either directly or through a recently established agent and broker network.
The company said it has offered the service on a wholesale level for the last three years.
